scope: Normalize logical LF and CRLF in standalone and embedded MTEXT content to the MTEXT paragraph token, while refusing bare CR and NUL before output publication.

behavior: The shared MTEXT chunk writer converts LF and CRLF to \P, including mixed input while preserving order.
Bare CR and NUL are rejected before the MTEXT chunk writer emits group bytes.
Standalone DRW_MText preflight uses MTEXT-specific content rules so logical line endings reach normalization; ordinary TEXT remains subject to generic text safety.
Embedded ATTRIB and ATTDEF MTEXT preflight uses the same MTEXT-specific rules.
Refusal on a standalone output route preserves the pre-existing destination.
coverage: LF, CRLF, mixed LF/CRLF, bare CR, and NUL
Standalone MTEXT, embedded ATTRIB MTEXT, and embedded ATTDEF MTEXT
Following LINE sentinel verifies record alignment

commands.note: Negative controls emit expected DXF format-error diagnostics before selector success.
